overall_prep_notes: Total prep ~1.5 hours. The two character puppets (Inspector If, Then) print on cardstock. Card decks (M1, M2, M3, M4, M5) are laminated. The detective poster (M10) is the visual centerpiece.

assets.name: IF-THEN Statement Cards
assets.purpose: 24 cards each showing an IF-THEN statement (everyday + math).
assets.page_layout: 4 letter pages, portrait. 6 cards per page.

image_placeholders.description: An IF-THEN card in B&W line-art, ~3in x 4in. Each shows a complete IF-THEN statement. Cut lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M1_IFTHEN_CARD: keywords (statement, card) name what the cards show.

assets.name: Condition Cards
assets.purpose: 12 condition cards (e.g., 'IF the number is even', 'IF it is sunny').
assets.page_layout: 2 letter pages, portrait. 6 cards per page.

image_placeholders.description: A condition card in B&W line-art, ~3in x 2in. Each shows a single condition starting with IF. Cut lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image M2_CONDITION_CARD: keywords (condition, card) name what the cards show.

assets.name: Action Cards
assets.purpose: 12 action cards (e.g., 'THEN clap', 'THEN take an umbrella').
assets.page_layout: 2 letter pages, portrait. 6 cards per page.

image_placeholders.description: An action card in B&W line-art, ~3in x 2in. Each shows a single action starting with THEN. Cut lines.
